The injured were transported to the Government Hospital in Markapuram, with five individuals in critical condition who will be transferred to Guntur GGH. **Markapuram** and **Nellore** authorities have set up control rooms for assistance.

recent_articles.title: Andhra Pradesh Markapuram road accident: Several killed, many injured after bus and truck collide - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **private travel bus** carrying 35-40 passengers from Nirmal in Telangana to Vinjamuru in Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh collided with a tipper vehicle loaded with gravel near Rayavaram in Markapuram district. The collision resulted in a massive fire, killing 13 people instantly and injuring 25 others.  The injured were taken to the Markapuram Government Hospital for treatment, with five critically injured passengers being transferred to Guntur GGH. **Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu** expressed shock and sorrow over the accident and directed officials to conduct a thorough investigation into the cause of the crash.

recent_articles.title: ArcelorMittal steel project first initiated by YSRCP government, claims Y.S. Jagan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **YSRCP** president Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy accused **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** of misleading propaganda regarding the proposed ArcelorMittal steel plant.  He claimed that groundwork for the plant was laid during his tenure as Chief Minister and not by the current NDA government, citing discussions with Aditya Mittal at Davos and prior site selections. Jagan Mohan Reddy also criticized the present government's handling of the Bulk Drug Park project in Nakkapalli, alleging land disputes and stagnation caused by deliberate actions. He further accused the government of high debt, corruption, and declining welfare delivery while promising greater opportunities for party workers in "Jagan 2.0."

recent_articles.title: CPI(M) demands rollback of G.O. on smart prepaid power meters - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **CPI(M)** State Committee demanded the withdrawal of **Andhra Pradesh** government's Order (GO) 22, which mandates smart prepaid electricity meters in government offices.  The party leader, **V. Srinivasa Rao**, criticized the move as a result of loan conditions imposed by the Centre and argued that it exposes the government's true intent behind power sector reforms. He expressed concern about potential disruptions to services at schools and anganwadi centres due to disconnections from lack of bill payments.

recent_articles.title: Minister warns officials over delay in irrigation projects - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nimmala Ramanaidu**, **Water Resources Minister**, held a video conference to review progress on major irrigation projects, expressing dissatisfaction with the slow pace of work, particularly on the Veligonda Project. He warned officials and agencies of strict action for delays and emphasized the government's commitment to completing these works within deadlines.  **Mr. Ramanaidu** directed officials to expedite construction of bridges at highway crossings and ensure completion of the Polavaram Left Main Canal before the upcoming season.

recent_articles.title: A.P. to launch digital system for streamlined medical bill reimbursements - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Department of Health, Medical Education, and Family Welfare** announced a new digital system for medical reimbursement under the **Employee Health Scheme (EHS)**.  Developed by the **A.P. Centre for Financial Systems and Services (APCFSS)**, the paperless system will streamline the process for government employees and pensioners, allowing them to submit, verify, and approve bills directly through a hospital login. The initiative aims to reduce delays and inconvenience caused by the current lengthy and multi-step process.

recent_articles.title: SVU Registrar urges students to pursue excellence in academics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sri Venkateswara University (SVU)** Registrar M. Bhoopathi Naidu released the first semester results for **N.P. Savithramma Government Women’s Degree College**, Chittoor, marking the institution's attainment of autonomous status.  The college achieved a pass percentage of 76.54% in its inaugural results, with Principal K. Manohar highlighting the college's strong performance across academics, sports, and extracurricular activities.

recent_articles.title: My fight is about Viveka’s murder, not property: Sharmila - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Y.S. Sharmila**, president of the **Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee**, clarified that her political struggle is focused on seeking justice for the murder of **YSR Vivekananda Reddy**, not family property disputes.  She refuted allegations by **YSRC Party leaders**, stating she has never discussed assets and her sole focus is exposing attempts to mislead the investigation into the case. **Ms. Sharmila** also accused **Y.S. Avinash Reddy** of promoting a "heart attack" theory to deflect blame, while demanding answers from **Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy** and his wife about media reports regarding a heart attack.

recent_articles.title: Krishna district court receives hoax bomb threat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Krishna District Court** officials were forced to evacuate the complex after receiving a hoax bomb threat via email. The **judge**, who received the message, alerted authorities, prompting a thorough search by police and bomb disposal units.  The investigation is ongoing with the **Chilakalapudi police** taking the lead.

recent_articles.title: Revanth Reddy is building his own band of loyalists - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister of Telangana, is consolidating his power within both the government and the state Congress party. He has appointed several young, recently joined Congress members to key positions, including Assembly and Legislative Council Whips.  This move signals a clear intention to shape the party's future leadership with his own loyalists. While a coordination committee was formed to bridge the gap between the government and the party, **Revanth Reddy**’s recent actions suggest he is determined to maintain control within the party structure.

recent_articles.title: Welfare of handloom artisans priority for government, says Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Minister for Handlooms and Textiles S. Savitha** visited the Gandhi Bunakar Mela (National Handloom Exhibition) in Vijayawada, emphasizing the **TDP-led coalition government's** commitment to handloom artisans' welfare.  She highlighted several initiatives including subsidies on raw materials, training in modern designs, and equipment purchase support, as well as a monthly pension for eligible workers. The exhibition showcased products from Andhra Pradesh and other regions, with sales exceeding ₹47.35 lakh since March 18th.

recent_articles.title: A.P. villages can develop only under NDA government, says R&B Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.C. Janardhan Reddy**, the **Roads and Buildings (R&B) Minister**, stated that villages in Andhra Pradesh can only develop under the NDA government, highlighting the significant development projects undertaken by his ministry in Palukuru village.  He emphasized the contrast between the previous TDP government's neglect of the village and the current NDA government's commitment to improving infrastructure and providing amenities. **Mr. Janardhan Reddy** also acknowledged the contributions made by the party's cadre despite leadership changes, while unveiling a statue of former Chief Minister N.T. Rama Rao.

recent_articles.title: BJP State chief assures to uplift potters, preserve traditional craft in A.P. - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P.V.N. Madhav**, **BJP State president**, assured the Kummari community of protection and enhancement for their traditional pottery craft, emphasizing its historical significance.  He praised the community's contribution to human evolution through earthen pots and highlighted the legacy of Shalivahana, a potter who rose to kingship. **Madhav** pledged to revive neglected government orders related to the welfare of potters and called for wider recognition of Shalivahana Jayanti as a State festival.  He also emphasized the community's strength and resilience and promised to stand with them.

recent_articles.title: Global crisis deepens due to war; CPI slams Modi’s silence - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Narayana**, national leader of the **Communist Party of India (CPI)**, expressed concern that the ongoing war in Iran is exacerbating a global economic crisis by benefiting corporate interests and causing widespread loss of life.  He criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for remaining silent on the conflict and urged him to exert pressure on **U.S. President Donald Trump**. **Dr. Narayana** also called for a "No War" protest in Hyderabad and emphasized the need for India to play a proactive role in promoting peace, while criticizing individuals facing allegations related to the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams.

recent_articles.title: AMRUT scheme worth ₹88.41 crore to change the face of Kavali in Nellore district: Lanka Dinakar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lanka Dinakar**, chairman of the 20-Point Programme Implementation Committee, announced that the **AMRUT** scheme in Kavali, Andhra Pradesh will provide clean drinking water to every household. The project, launched by the then Union Minister **M. Venkaiah Naidu**, was previously shelved but has been relaunched by the current government.  **Sravan Kumar**, Civic Commissioner of Nellore district, and engineering officials are working to expedite the project's implementation.

recent_articles.title: CII Meet Outlines Roadmap for ‘Swarna Andhra 2047’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **CII-Andhra Pradesh** held its annual meeting and conference on 'Swarna Andhra Pradesh' at Novotel hotel, outlining a strategic roadmap for the state's transition into a global industrial powerhouse by 2047. **Union Minister for Civil Aviation K. Rammohan Naidu**, attending as the chief guest, praised the favorable environment for the vision and highlighted the transformation of North Coastal Andhra (Uttarandhra).  **CII Southern Region Chairman Thomas John Muthoot** emphasized the state's importance to South India's economic progress. **S. Narendra Kumar** was appointed chairperson of CII-Andhra Pradesh for 2026-27, while **Murali Krishna Gannamani** presided over the program.

recent_articles.title: Barashaheed Dargah will be developed at cost of ₹9.8 crore, says A.P. Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **P. Narayana**, **Andhra Pradesh Waqf Board Chairman Abdul Aziz**, and other officials visited the Barashaheed Dargah in Nellore to participate in Eid-ul-Fitr prayers.  The **MA&UD Minister** announced plans to resume development of the Dargah, which had stalled during the previous YSRCP administration. The **Minister** also confirmed the construction of a nation's first international school for minorities on land belonging to the Waqf Board at a cost of ₹20 crore.

recent_articles.title: NITI Aayog extends ₹1.55 crore financial aid to Guntupalli RISE centre: Collector - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NITI Aayog** has approved a ₹1.55 crore financial assistance for the Rural Incubation, Skilling and Entrepreneurship (RISE) centre in Guntupalli, Andhra Pradesh. The funds will support initiatives such as an AI-based skills survey, skill development programs, infrastructure creation, and help women entrepreneurs become successful.  The center, established under Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu's vision of 'One Family, One Entrepreneur', has trained over 1,000 women in various fields and facilitated the establishment of 300 businesses.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu prays at Tirumala temple; eats at Annadanam complex - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** visited the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple on Saturday to mark his grandson Nara Devansh's birthday.  Accompanied by his wife, **Nara Bhuvaneswari**, and son, **Minister for IT Nara Lokesh**, he received traditional temple honors and paid obeisance to the deity. During his visit, **Naidu** interacted with pilgrims, seeking feedback on TTD facilities and promised to explore AI solutions for faster darshan times.  He also donated ₹44 lakh towards one day's Annaprasadam service at Tirumala.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu inaugurates food analysis laboratory in Tirumala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** inaugurated a state-of-the-art food analysis laboratory in Tirumala to enhance food and water safety standards for pilgrims visiting the hill shrine.  The facility, developed with financial support from **FSSAI** and the **State government**, is equipped with advanced instruments to analyze up to 1,500 samples per month.  Officials from **FSSAI** and the **Central Food Technological Research Institute (CFTRI)** briefed **Naidu** on the laboratory's capabilities during his inspection.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu calls for transforming TTD temples into advanced spiritual hubs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** reviewed the operations of the Artificial Intelligence-enabled Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC) at the Vaikuntham Queue Complex, emphasizing the need for transforming temples under the **Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam (TTD)** into state-of-the-art spiritual centers.  He directed officials to strengthen systems anticipating potential pilgrim inconveniences and deploy advanced surveillance infrastructure, including high-resolution CCTV cameras and facial recognition systems.  **Naidu** also called for sustainable development measures, expansion of medical services, capacity building for temple volunteers, and institutionalization of best practices for national benchmarks in temple management.

recent_articles.title: ​Chandrababu opts for general queue at Tirumala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** chose to have darshan of Lord Venkateswara at Tirumala with the general public on Saturday, March 21, 2026, in celebration of his grandson Devaansh's birthday.  He bypassed the VVIP queue and joined devotees through the regular queue system, a practice he has followed in the past. **Naidu** expressed gratitude to the Lord for saving him from a bomb blast at Alipiri and attributed it to the family's devotion. The family donated ₹44 lakh to the Tarigonda Vengamamba Annadanam Trust and served meals to devotees after darshan.

recent_articles.title: Job calendar a big let down for unemployed youth in A.P., says DYFI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DYFI** leaders protested against the recently released job calendar, criticizing its lack of transparency and inadequate vacancy numbers. They accused the government of failing to fulfill promises made regarding police constable, Group 1 and 2 service, university, DSC, and Special Education posts. **Ramanna**, State secretary of **DYFI**, demanded a revised job calendar with increased vacancies and an expanded age limit for candidates.

recent_articles.title: Outdoor Stadium in Kurnool to be developed with more infrastructure - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T.G. Bharath**, **Minister for Industries and Commerce**, laid the foundation for a synthetic walking track and other sporting facilities at the Outdoor Stadium in Vijayawada, with construction costing ₹2.5 crore. The project aims to develop three international-standard sporting facilities at the stadium, which is being constructed by **Greenko** at TIDCO housing complex.  The development is part of the NDA government's efforts to improve sports infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh, and will be completed within three months.

recent_articles.title: Grand Ugadi celebrations organised in Andhra - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector Rajakumari Ganiya**, **Temple Executive Officer M. Srinivasa Rao**, and other officials participated in the grand Ugadi Mahotsavams at the Sri Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Swamy temple in Srisailam.  **Dr. Butta Veerabhadra Daivagya** read the panchangam, outlining potential challenges for governments and auspicious events for individuals. **Minister for Industries and Commerce T.G. Bharath** expressed hope for a smooth year ahead under **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu**, while celebrations were also held in Kurnool and Sri Sathya Sai district.
